# Cocktale

> Personalized cocktail discovery for home bartenders. Match a drink to tonight's weather and mood, open the full recipe, keep a tasting journal, and shop ingredients or bar tools.

Site: https://cocktale.vercel.app

## For people

- What should I drink tonight? → https://cocktale.vercel.app/feed
- Classic cocktail recipes A–Z → https://cocktale.vercel.app/catalogue
- Gin / whiskey / vodka / rum / tequila guides → https://cocktale.vercel.app/cocktails/gin
- Home bar shop → https://cocktale.vercel.app/market
- Tasting journal → https://cocktale.vercel.app/journey
- Contact → https://cocktale.vercel.app/contact

## Notes

Recipes are for adults of legal drinking age. Drink responsibly.
